turns.content: At locus P, P2 is a fully recessive deleterious allele: only P2P2 has fitness 1-s, while P1 is favored and mutates to P2 at rate mu with no back mutation. What are the fitnesses of P1P1 and P1P2?
For s=0.1 and mu=0.0001, apply recessive mutation-selection balance to derive the equilibrium frequency q of P2.
Convert q to the equilibrium frequency p of favored P1 and give a sensible rounded value.
Report the three requested quantities as w(P1P1), w(P1P2), and p(P1).
Check the allele labels and explain why a recessive deleterious allele uses q approximately sqrt(mu/s), not the linear dominant-allele balance.
Give the favored allele, its equilibrium frequency, and the two genotype fitnesses.
